phases.name: Phase 1 - Foundation
phases.focus: Build base conditioning with run/walk intervals and easy cardiovascular movements.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Build
phases.focus: Increase continuous running time gradually while maintaining controlled intensity.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Peak Prep
phases.focus: Sharpen endurance and pacing toward 5K with progressive load and run quality.

non_negotiables: Careful with cold air at intensity

stage2.text:
PLAN "Couch-to-5K for a client with exercise-induced asthma"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary sport:
    name "5K running readiness"
PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Warm-up / mobility training 15m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          dynamic_mlex 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_interval 4x2x60 s rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_breathing_cooldown 5m
      DAY Run / run-walk session training 25m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_interval 8x60 s run 60 s walk rpe 3 rest 0s
        cooldown:
          light jog 5m
      DAY Strength / stability training 20m:
        warmup:
          shoulder_meb 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45
          bird_dog 3x10 each side rpe 3 rest 30
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Core recovery 15m:
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10 each side rpe 3 rest 0
          side_plank 2x20s each side rpe 2 rest 0
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Warm-up / mobility training 15m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
          hip_mircle 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_interval 5x60 s run 60 s walk rpe 3 rest 0s
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing 5m
      DAY Run / run-walk session training 28m:
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk_interval 9x60 s run 60 s walk rpe 3 rest 0s
        cooldown:
          easy_jog 5m
      DAY Strength / stability training 22m:
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          lateral_band_walk 3x12 each side rpe 3 rest 45
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Core recovery 15m:
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hollow_hold 3x20s rpe 2
          russian_twist 3x12 each side rpe 3
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Warm-up / mobility training 16m:

      DAY Run / run-walk session training 30m:

      DAY Core recovery 15m:

        cooldown:
          forward_fold_rag 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Warm-up / mobility training 18m:
